description: This file defines the ModuleStatusChange event class within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates the state change of a module, specifically storing previous and current module instances.

classes.name: ModuleStatusChange
classes.description: An event class representing the status change of a module, encapsulating previous and current module states.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the previous and current module states.

methods.name: getPreviousModule
methods.description: Returns the previous state of the module before the change.

methods.name: getCurrentModule
methods.description: Returns the current state of the module after the change.
